title: Baghdad Phantom: seven still images, then video in the government's first release
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Baghdad Phantom: seven still images, then video in the government's first release, about unspecified; reported about 3 years before the release at Baghdad, Iraq, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.
